hero.eyebrow: A quiet atlas of where you've been
hero.title: The world, the way you traveled it.
hero.sub: MyJourney keeps every trip you take and traces it across the globe — cities, routes, and the years between them. Your own atlas, quietly filling in.

features.title: Not a trip planner. A place your travels live.
features.lead: Booking tools forget you the moment you land. MyJourney does the opposite — it holds onto where you went, and hands it back as a world you can see.

items.title: Keep every trip
items.body: A city, a date, how you got there. That's a memory saved — not a form to fill out.

items.title: See it all at once
items.body: Watch your travels connect on a living globe. Every route you've flown, driven, or sailed, drawn in one line.

items.title: Find your next one
items.body: Places you loved, and quiet nudges toward the ones you haven't reached yet.

steps.title: From an empty map to your own atlas.

items.title: Add a trip
items.body: Two cities and how you traveled between them. It takes a few seconds.

items.title: Watch it draw
items.body: Your route arcs across the map, city to city, the moment you save it.

items.title: Grow your atlas
items.body: Trip by trip, the empty map stops being the world's and starts being yours.

atlas.eyebrow: One traveler's year, as an example
atlas.title: A year, once it's on the map.
atlas.journalQuote: “Third time back here. The map remembered before I did.”

footer.title: Your map is waiting to be drawn.
footer.sub: Start with one trip. The world fills in from there.
